newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian lending rate rises to 11.9 vs 9.8 pct.
newsitem.headline: Croatian lending rate rises to 11.9 vs 9.8 pct.

text.p: The Croatian average lending rate rose to 11.9 percent on Wednesday from 9.8 percent, propelled by a higher volume of longer-term settlements.
Trade totalled 39.1 million kuna, mostly made up of fresh borrowings, with 9.1 million rolled over.
Call money loans were granted at 10-11 percent.
Rates for term loans were 11.9 percent for six-month funds, 14 percent for 15-day and 16 percent for two-month loans. Insurers rolled over previous placements at 13 percent.
One new six-month loan was struck at the average rate after regular trade closed.
The National Bank of Croatia's kuna midrates for Thursday eased to 5.6811 from 5.6533 to the dollar and very slightly to 3.5596 against the German mark. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
